name: Filikod
author: Filikod

sections.description:
Filikod is a lightweight WordPress plugin that improves image handling and media performance.
It provides automatic image resizing on upload, ALT text cleanup, secure SVG support, and bulk processing for existing images.

The plugin works with all WordPress themes and page builders (Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, WPBakery, etc.) and requires no advanced configuration.

Features

🔧 Image Optimization

  • Automatic image resizing on upload (configurable max width).
  • Reduced file sizes through more appropriate dimensions.
  • Bulk processing for existing images.
  • Metadata update after optimization.

📝 ALT Text Tools

  • Automatic generation of ALT text based on the file name.
  • Cleanup of special characters for cleaner ALT attributes.
  • Automatic removal of redundant title attributes for accessibility.

🔒 Secure SVG Support

  • Validation of file extension and MIME type.
  • XML sanitization to remove unauthorized elements.
  • Automatic blocking of potentially harmful tags (script, iframe, etc.).

📁 Extended File Type Support

  • Enable/disable additional file types (SVGZ, PSD, AI, EPS, ICO, ZIP, RAR, 7Z, WEBM…)
  • Simple toggle-based interface.

📊 Admin Interface

  • Dashboard with useful media information.
  • Settings organized into tabs for clarity.
  • AJAX-based bulk processing to avoid timeouts.
  • Responsive and multisite-compatible interface.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • Compatible with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, WPBakery and all major page builders.
  • Compatible with all themes.
  • Works with both GD and Imagick PHP extensions.
  • Fully multisite compatible.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin via the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate it through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Filikod > Settings to adjust the available options.

Filikod will automatically resize newly uploaded images.
The bulk optimization tool can be used to process existing images already in the Media Library.
sections.faq:
Does Filikod replace my original images?

Yes. When resizing is enabled, the original image is replaced with the resized version to save disk space. WordPress metadata remains intact.

Is Filikod compatible with all page builders?

Yes. Optimized images are automatically used everywhere, including Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, WPBakery, and others.

Can I optimize existing images?

Yes. The bulk processing tools allow you to resize and clean ALT attributes for all existing images.

Can I use Filikod with other optimization plugins?

Yes, as long as they are not performing the same resizing actions. It is recommended to use only one resizing plugin at a time.

Does Filikod support WebP or AVIF?

Support for WebP/AVIF conversion will be added in a future release.

Where can I get support?

Documentation and support are available at: https://filikod.com/
